MLI.note: The article is about a media ban and a site block and gives no price for mobile data.

facts.fact: Jeune Afrique says the Malian authorities banned distribution of the magazine on 17 January 2026, accusing it of apology for terrorism, defamation and incitement to hatred over its coverage, including of the fuel crisis.
Jeune Afrique says Malian readers report its website has been blocked since late January 2026, and that the authorities have not officially announced the block.
